test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate returns 400 when config not set
test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint returns 400 with descriptive error when ai_retry_config is not configured
steps: Ensure ai_retry_config is null in settings
POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate with { log_id: 'any' }
Verify 400 response with { success: false, error: '...' }

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate returns 404 when log not found
test_cases.description: Verify that the endpoint returns 404 when the specified log_id does not exist
steps: Set ai_retry_config in settings
POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate with { log_id: 'nonexistent-id' }
Verify 404 response

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate rejects 2xx response without error features
test_cases.description: Verify that the pre-check rejects successful responses without error indicators
steps: Set ai_retry_config, insert a log with status_code=200, no error_message, normal response body
POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate with the log_id
Verify response { success: false, error: '该请求响应正常，无需生成重试规则' }

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate generates rule from 503 error response
test_cases.description: Verify successful rule generation from an overloaded 503 response
steps: Set ai_retry_config with a working provider, insert a 503 error log
Mock LLM to return valid rule JSON
POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate with the log_id
Verify response { success: true, rule: {...}, summary: '...' }

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate handles AI exit (no rule)
test_cases.description: Verify that AI's error response (no rule generated) is properly forwarded
steps: Mock LLM to return { error: '无法从此响应中提取重试规则：...' }
POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate
Verify response { success: false, error: '无法从...' }

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate validates AI response fields
test_cases.description: Verify that missing or invalid fields in AI response are caught
steps: Mock LLM to return JSON missing 'summary' field
POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate
Verify response contains validation error

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate validates body_pattern regex
test_cases.description: Verify that invalid regex in AI response body_pattern is rejected
steps: Mock LLM to return rule with body_pattern '[invalid'
POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate
Verify response contains regex validation error

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate uses stream_text_content fallback
test_cases.description: Verify that when upstream_response is null, stream_text_content is used for analysis
steps: Insert a streaming log with upstream_response=null, stream_text_content='error text'
POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate
Verify successful rule generation

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate includes existing rules in prompt
test_cases.description: Verify that the system prompt contains existing active retry rules
steps: Create existing retry rules in DB
Capture LLM request body
Verify system message contains existing rule names and patterns

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate returns error when provider not found
test_cases.description: Verify error when the configured provider_id does not exist
steps: Set ai_retry_config with nonexistent provider_id
POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate
Verify error response about provider not found

test_cases.title: POST /admin/api/retry-rules/ai-generate truncates response over 4000 chars
test_cases.description: Verify that response text is truncated at 4000 characters before sending to AI
steps: Insert a log with upstream_response longer than 4000 chars
Capture LLM request
Verify user prompt response body is at most 4000 chars

test_cases.title: GET /admin/api/proxy-enhancement includes ai_retry_config
test_cases.description: Verify that the config endpoint returns ai_retry_config field
steps: Set ai_retry_config in settings
GET /admin/api/proxy-enhancement
Verify response contains ai_retry_config with provider_id and model

test_cases.title: PUT /admin/api/proxy-enhancement saves ai_retry_config
test_cases.description: Verify that ai_retry_config can be saved through the proxy-enhancement endpoint
steps: PUT /admin/api/proxy-enhancement with ai_retry_config: { provider_id: 'x', model: 'y' }
GET /admin/api/proxy-enhancement
Verify ai_retry_config is persisted

test_cases.title: PUT /admin/api/proxy-enhancement clears ai_retry_config with null
test_cases.description: Verify that setting ai_retry_config to null clears the config
steps: PUT with ai_retry_config: null
GET /admin/api/proxy-enhancement
Verify ai_retry_config is null

test_cases.title: ProxyEnhancement page shows AI config card with CascadingModelSelect
test_cases.description: Verify the AI retry rule config section appears on the proxy enhancement page
steps: Navigate to /admin/proxy-enhancement
Verify 'AI 重试规则生成' card is visible
Verify CascadingModelSelect dropdown is present
Select a provider and model
Click save
Reload page and verify selection is preserved

test_cases.title: UnifiedRequestDialog shows generate button in left sidebar
test_cases.description: Verify the sparkle button appears in the log detail dialog
steps: Navigate to /admin/logs
Open a log detail dialog
Verify '生成重试规则' button with sparkle icon is visible in left panel

test_cases.title: Generate button shows loading state during AI call
test_cases.description: Verify the button enters loading state while AI is processing
steps: Click '生成重试规则' button
Verify button shows spinner and '分析中...' text
Verify button is disabled during loading

test_cases.title: Config prompt dialog opens when AI not configured
test_cases.description: Verify the configuration prompt dialog with 'go to config' button
steps: Ensure ai_retry_config is not set
Click '生成重试规则'
Verify dialog '需要配置 AI 模型' appears
Click '前往配置'
Verify new tab opens /admin/proxy-enhancement
Verify log detail dialog remains open

test_cases.title: AI rule preview dialog shows all fields pre-filled
test_cases.description: Verify the preview dialog displays AI-generated rule with editable fields
steps: Configure AI, trigger generation on an error log
Verify preview dialog opens
Verify AI summary is displayed at top (green border)
Verify all fields (name, status_code, body_pattern, strategy, delays, retries, active toggle) are pre-filled
Verify all fields are editable

test_cases.title: Save generated rule to retry rules list
test_cases.description: Verify the rule is saved and appears in the retry rules page
steps: Generate and preview a rule
Click '保存规则'
Verify success toast
Navigate to /admin/retry-rules
Verify the new rule is in the list

test_cases.title: Edit rule before saving
test_cases.description: Verify that modifying fields in the preview dialog takes effect
steps: Generate a rule
Change name and retry_strategy in the preview dialog
Save
Verify the saved rule in the list has the modified values

test_cases.title: End-to-end: config → generate → preview → save
test_cases.description: Full flow from configuring AI to generating and saving a retry rule
steps: Navigate to proxy enhancement, configure AI provider/model
Save and verify
Navigate to logs, open an error log
Click generate button, wait for AI response
Preview dialog shows AI suggestion with summary
Save the rule
Verify rule in retry rules list
Verify rule is active and matches the error pattern

test_cases.title: RetryRuleMatcher cache refreshes after saving AI-generated rule
test_cases.description: Verify that the in-memory retry rule cache is updated when a rule is saved from AI preview
steps: Generate and save a rule for status 503 with pattern 'overloaded'
Make a proxy request that returns 503 with 'overloaded' in body
Verify the retry logic triggers for this request
